nodes.label: HTTP Client
nodes.notes: End user or external system that uploads a file via HTTP POST to the EC2 instance.

nodes.label: Upload Bucket
nodes.notes: S3 bucket that durably stores the uploaded files; versioning is enabled and public access is fully blocked.

nodes.label: Upload Notification Topic
nodes.notes: SNS topic that fans out upload notifications; the email subscription delivers a message to wangharold001@gmail.com on every file upload.

nodes.label: wangharold001@gmail.com
nodes.notes: Email endpoint subscribed to the SNS topic via the EmailSubscription construct; AWS will send a confirmation email before messages are delivered.

nodes.label: Upload Server
nodes.notes: Upload server on a t3.micro (2 vCPUs, 1 GiB RAM, x86_64). Sits in the middle of the pipeline — receives HTTP POST uploads from the client and writes files directly to the S3 Upload Bucket, then publishes an SNS notification.

edges.label: Email subscription
edges.notes: Uses aws-cdk-lib/aws-sns-subscriptions EmailSubscription; the subscriber must confirm the opt-in email before messages are delivered.

edges.label: HTTP POST /upload
edges.notes: HTTP client sends a multipart file upload POST request directly to the EC2 instance.

edges.label: PutObject (file)
edges.notes: EC2 instance profile role must be granted s3:PutObject on the Upload Bucket.

edges.label: Publish notification
edges.notes: EC2 instance profile role must be granted sns:Publish on the Upload Notification Topic after a successful S3 PutObject.
